note: P3 content — the FEED THE RIFT window names executions[0].

executions.name: Long Hour
executions.script: It sets them down, sits facing them, and waits. The round timer appears and runs. It does nothing. The loser tries to crawl. The timer hits zero and so do they — the only Execution where the winner never touches the loser at all.

executions.name: Overpressure
executions.script: It embraces them and opens every vent inward. One frame of a person becoming a pressure vessel, and then the arena is very bright and very quiet, and there is a shadow on the wall behind where it stood.

desecration.name: Still Standing
desecration.script: The advance continues past the bell; the freeze-frame is the far arena wall.

overdrive.name: TERMINAL VELOCITY
overdrive.script: Every vent opens at once. It walks — just walks — through the entire arena, and the camera stays behind it, and whatever was in the way is behind it too.
